rule: the low vowel fronts by default
an unstressed non-low non-nasalized vowel reduces to schwa before a consonant or word end
schwa epenthesized after an obstruent + sonorant consonant, before optional consonants + word end
t voices to d before a nasal consonant
a vowel shortens before a consonant cluster ending in a nasal
an identical consonant geminate reduces to one (recurrence)
final ə becomes a non-syllabic off-glide
the final off-glide schwa is deleted elsewhere
stress is leveled — no longer distinctive
